# Version 4.156.1 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering correctness fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.1 collects rendering and Vulkan synchronization corrections while retaining Skia m156. The collected fixes improve transformed geometry, displacement sampling and GPU flush handling without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **More accurate transformed shapes and filters** — Corrects ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke transforms, clamps corner radii to prevent overlap, and uses float-precision displacement offsets to match filter bounds. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687), [#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))
- **Safer GPU flush and clip recording** — Prevents stale atlas work after empty Ganesh flushes. Graphite counts pending clips against pass capacity and warns and skips a draw whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Correct native Vulkan wait results** — Synchronous native submission now accounts for fence-wait failures. GRContext.Submit remains void: this does not add a managed failure result or exception, and asynchronous submission is unchanged. ([#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))
